text: So long as men worship the Caesars and Napoleons, Caesars and Napoleons will duly rise and make them miserable.
author: Aldous Huxley
visual_brief: Architectural cross-section of a colossal monolithic pedestal towering over thin, fragile foundations, with stress lines and downward force vectors showing the bedrock cracking beneath its immense dead load. Clean white technical drafting lines on black, complete with structural dimension marks and section hatching.
alt: Architectural cross-section of a colossal stone pedestal cracking its structural foundations.
